title: pyrus morula
intro: Pyrus morula, commonly known as the Chinese pear or sand pear, is a deciduous tree species native to China. The health benefits of Pyrus morula include its potential to aid in weight loss, improve digestion, and reduce inflammation due to its high fiber and antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of Pyrus morula include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve cardiovascular health, and exert anti-cancer properties. Pyrus morula contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
